name: @awacloud/tool-convert
description: Document conversion (@awacloud/oconv) at the command line and over MCP: to-md, from-md, convert and to-html, on Bun, Node and Deno

awa._coverageComment: Basis = this package's own src/** rows. The canonical All-files aggregate is dominated by @awacloud/oconv, @awacloud/md and @awacloud/fw, which the in-process core tests load by design (measured 2026-09-23: 26.87% over 533 rows, 530 of them foreign), so it tracks those packages' reach, not this one. Basis rows: src/core.ts, src/descriptors.ts, src/mcp.ts, src/timestamp.ts (the fourth since 2026-09-24). src/index.ts and src/runtime.ts carry no lcov row: the CLI is exercised only as a spawned child process (cli, runtime-matrix integration tests), which instruments nothing in the parent run. Measured 2026-09-23 with the repository coverage gate: 94.89% lines = the gate's unweighted mean of the three rows (core.ts 98.28, descriptors.ts 100.00, mcp.ts 86.39; the pooled line ratio would be 397/447 = 88.81%, not the gate's model). floor = (floor(94.89) - 2)/100 = 0.92, the oconv-fonts rule. With three rows, 2 points of mean is 6 points on one row (about 22 of mcp.ts's 360 lines): a small refactor lands without a re-declaration, while losing src/mcp.test.ts (the only in-process importer of src/mcp.ts) fails the gate. Re-measured 2026-09-24 with src/timestamp.ts in the basis: 96.25% over four rows (core.ts 98.36, descriptors.ts 100.00, mcp.ts 86.65, timestamp.ts 100.00); floor unchanged at 0.92.
